# Wonder World Kids Learning
> Official Web & PWA Educational Gaming Suite for Children Aged 3–8.
Website: https://wonderworldkidslearning.space

## Overview
Wonder World Kids Learning is a 100% offline-compatible, browser-installable PWA educational gaming suite designed for young children (ages 3–8). It features 45 interactive mini-games across 5 learning worlds: Math & Numbers, Reading & Words, Science & Discovery, Logic & Puzzles, and Creative Arts.

## Key Features & Safety Principles
- 100% Ad-Free & Offline Capable: Runs locally in any modern browser via Service Worker and Progressive Web App technology. No active internet connection needed after installation.
- COPPA & GDPR-K Conscious Design: Zero tracking analytics, zero external user data collection, zero third-party ads or hidden microtransactions.
- Parent Control Gate: Math-challenge parental PIN protection before accessing billing, settings, or external web links.
- Single One-Time Payment: $9.00 USD lifetime access with no recurring subscriptions or micro-purchases.
- Interactive Free Demo: Sample games playable directly on the website without registration.

## Target Audience & Geographic Support
- Target Age: 3 to 8 years old.
- Supported Regions: United States, United Kingdom, Germany, France, Australia, Singapore, United Arab Emirates (Dubai/Middle East), Europe, and Africa.
- Supported Platforms: Android (PWA), iOS / iPadOS (Add to Home Screen), Desktop Chrome/Edge/Safari/Firefox (PWA & Offline Launcher).

## Legal & Operational Transparency
- All game progress is stored locally in the user's browser (localStorage / IndexedDB).
- Payment processing is handled via secure client-side PayPal Checkout verification.
- Offline desktop launchers and zip packages provide offline web server execution for home or classroom desktop environments.
